speaker: Grace
text: Tata, don't walk yet. I wrote down everything that happened since you left. Number one. Boppy saw the Big One again.

speaker: Rose
text: It's bigger than a BUS! It ate a boat!

speaker: Grace
text: It did not eat a boat. Nobody's ever seen it but Boppy, and he's been saying it for twenty years.

speaker: Tom
text: Twenty years, one witness. That's a strong number one. What's number two?

speaker: Grace
text: Number two. Deedee made apple muffins. They're for you, so nobody's allowed to have one yet.

speaker: Rose
text: I licked one. Only the top!

speaker: Tom
text: Thank you for telling me, Rose. That one's yours. Grace, I'm so sorry, but number two can't wait.

speaker: Grace
text: Number three. Rose licked a muffin.

speaker: Amy
text: Brother! I'm watching you from the window. I've seen people move faster walking on the sand at Robert Moses.

speaker: Tom
text: I'm carrying a child and receiving a news report.

speaker: Amy
text: I carried both of them up that street with the groceries. Go see Mom. I'm coming over after my run.

speaker: Tom
text: Your mother says I'm slow.

speaker: Grace
text: You are slow. I've been on number four since the mailbox.

speaker: Aunt Ellie
text: Tom. They gave you a seat that turns into a bed, and you still got off that plane wrinkled.

speaker: Tom
text: Hi, Aunt Ellie. It's a travel wrinkle. It's supposed to fall out by dinner.

speaker: Aunt Ellie
text: Then I'll look at you again at dinner. Come in. Rose, darling, what is that on your hands?

speaker: Rose
text: Cinnamon! From Deedee's muffin!

speaker: Aunt Ellie
text: Then you'll stay up there, please. Your uncle wipes clean. My chairs don't.

speaker: Grace
text: Aunt Ellie, I'm reading Tata everything he missed. You're number four.

speaker: Aunt Ellie
text: Am I? What did I do?

speaker: Grace
text: You got new curtains.

speaker: Aunt Ellie
text: I did. And what's number three?

speaker: Grace
text: Rose licked a muffin.

speaker: Aunt Ellie
text: Then the curtains are three, Grace. Fix your list. I'm not coming in behind a licked muffin.

speaker: Rose
text: Aunt Ellie, did you miss Tata?

speaker: Aunt Ellie
text: Fine. The street was quieter without him, and I didn't care for it. Now go and see your mother, Tom, before I change my mind.

speaker: Deedee
text: There he is! Come here. Let me look at you. I missed that face. Now sit, you're having a muffin.

speaker: Tom
text: Hi, Mom. I missed yours too. Is that the cinnamon topping? I've been thinking about that topping since we flew over Kansas.

speaker: Deedee
text: Twelve of them, and all twelve are still there. I've been standing between that pan and your father since six this morning.

speaker: Boppy
text: In my own kitchen! Tom, back at Rikers I had a key to every door in the place, and here I can't get near a muffin. You know, one time a fella tried to walk out of the mess hall with a whole loaf of bread under his hat...

speaker: Rose
text: AHHH! DEEDEE!

speaker: Tom
text: GAH! I'm on the floor. Grace, is that your elbow or mine?

speaker: Grace
text: It's mine! Tata, get UP, it's getting away!

speaker: Deedee
text: That thing took my good twelve-cup pan! I don't even put that pan in the DISHWASHER.

speaker: Boppy
text: ...and I only caught him because the hat kept getting taller. Where'd the muffins go?

speaker: Deedee
text: A ball of mud came through the door and took them. Pan and all.

speaker: Boppy
text: The mud gets a muffin and I don't?

speaker: Deedee
text: Girls, sneakers. Tom, hold the door. Hubby, you stay right there. When we get them back, the first one's yours.

speaker: Boppy
text: The first one. Tom, you heard her.

speaker: Rose
text: Hello, mud! Can we please have Deedee's muffins back? Thank you!

speaker: Mudling
text: No. Ours now.

speaker: Rose
text: But I said PLEASE!

speaker: Tom
text: She did. I was right here. It was an excellent please.

speaker: Deedee
text: Girls, behind me. You three have till I count to three. Then I'm getting the hose.

speaker: Deedee
text: Three.

speaker: Grace
text: Nine papers. There were twelve. So the one with the pan still has three.

speaker: Deedee
text: Then it has three of my muffins and my pan. Keep walking.

speaker: Rose
text: The grass is Boppy color!

speaker: Grace
text: It's grey, Rose. Just that one spot. And that orange cube has a dragonfly in it.

speaker: Rose
text: He's stuck! Tata, get him out!

speaker: Tom
text: Yes. Right away. Everybody give the dragonfly some room.

speaker: Tom
text: It's the size of a plum. I carried a suitcase through two airports this morning.

speaker: Rose
text: Your face is RED, Tata!

speaker: Grace
text: Tata, stop. You're getting fingerprints on it. And look, it has a dent. Did you do that?

speaker: Tom
text: Grace. I couldn't even make it wobble.

speaker: Grace
text: Deedee, what's that?

speaker: Deedee
text: A flashbulb, from an old camera. It's burnt. Somebody set it off right here and left it by your grandfather's chair.

speaker: Grace
text: Don't throw it out! It's a clue. I'm starting a new list. Burnt bulb. Grey grass. Orange cube with a dragonfly in it. I'm writing it in pencil.

speaker: Tom
text: Why pencil?

speaker: Grace
text: Because I don't know what any of it means yet.

speaker: Tom
text: GAH! Grace, I'm holding your hand. That's for me, not for you.

speaker: Grace
text: I know, Tata. You're squeezing. Is that the Big One? Boppy only said it was as big as the couch!

speaker: Deedee
text: For once in his life he rounded down.

speaker: The Big One
text: GLUB. I was small at breakfast. Then a flash. Now I don't fit under my log.

speaker: Deedee
text: And that's my good twelve-cup pan on your head. It's never been in pond water in its life.

speaker: The Big One
text: It's my crown. A little muddy one brought it. I'm keeping it.

speaker: Tom
text: Mom. That's a boss. You don't just walk up to a boss.

speaker: Deedee
text: I worked the night shift, Tom. I've walked up to worse. Mister, take off my pan.

speaker: Rose
text: BOO!

speaker: The Big One
text: GLUB! HA! You got me! I see everybody. I never saw you!

speaker: Tom
text: Nobody does. She's gotten me in an empty room.

speaker: The Big One
text: Take the pan. The sneaky one gets this. It's the only thing I've got.

speaker: Rose
text: Thank you, fish! There's a bug on my money!

speaker: The Big One
text: The man in the folding chair. Will he be back?

speaker: Grace
text: That's Boppy. He's here every single day.

speaker: The Big One
text: Good. He was in the middle of a story. The one about the race.

speaker: Deedee
text: He's been in the middle of that one for fifty-one years.

speaker: Rose
text: Boppy! Your fish is REAL! He's CAR size and he gave me money!

speaker: Boppy
text: CAR size? Cozy Rosie, I told everybody a couch. Twenty years! I didn't want to brag!

speaker: Boppy
text: Now that's real gold. Same as these. Look.

speaker: Rose
text: You've got money in your TEETH!

speaker: Boppy
text: Safest place there is. Gold is for keeping, Cozy Rosie. You put that where nobody's going to look.

speaker: Rose
text: Under Lamby! Nobody looks under Lamby!

speaker: Boppy
text: Good girl. Now. Your grandmother promised me the first muffin. Who's got my muffin?

speaker: Grace
text: The fish ate them, Boppy. The last three.

speaker: Boppy
text: The fish gets THREE?

speaker: Deedee
text: Twelve more. Forty minutes. The first one's still yours.

speaker: Boppy
text: Girls, you heard that. Forty minutes. Somebody watch the clock.

speaker: Grace
text: Tata, you have a job. If you see anything grey in California, or an orange cube, you write it down and text me.

speaker: Tom
text: I have a job. Yes. Does the job come with a pencil?

speaker: Grace
text: That's my second best one. Don't lose it.

speaker: Tom
text: Second best. It's going in the pocket with the zipper.

speaker: Rose
text: One more ride, Tata! To the cab! Go the LONG way!

speaker: Tom
text: The long way. That's all the way around the Square. Twice.

speaker: TNB
text: hey babe. safe flight. the smog over 2nd ave turned purple this morning. it'll probably blow over.
